title: Consistent Technical Documents Using Emacs and Org Mode
summary: A demo of writing technical documents in Emacs Org mode using org-babel, so that code blocks and generated content stay consistent when things change. The author shares the demo files and his dotfiles.
why: HN commenters recommend it as a practical illustration of what Org mode and literate programming can do for documentation.

quote.text: I think does a pretty good job of illustrating the power of Org.
